spec.title: vscode-extension PROP-005: Upgrade advisory, conventions and generators - the feature skeleton, the brand table, the leftover guard

status.comment: the type's answers to the advisory, conventions and generators questions of PROP-016 §2, written 2026-11-01 from DESIGN-002 §2 and §4

p.VSX-ADVISORY-READERS: The readers the cycle runs between two pins, all over `<extensionRoot>/package.json` unless named otherwise: `engines-vscode` (the value of `engines.vscode`; a change is news by itself), `manifest-version` (`version`), `configuration-keys` (the sorted keys of every `contributes.configuration` section), `activation-events` (`activationEvents`), `package-manager` (the `packageManager` field of the root manifest, when the tree is a monorepo), and `locale-manifests` (the sorted list of `package.nls*.json` the patch set names in `typeConfig.localeManifests`, each read for presence). A reader never throws on an absent file and refuses an unreadable one with `brokenArtifact` (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-AREA-ADVISORY`).

p.VSX-ADVISORY-MEANINGS: What a change means, one sentence each: a moved `engines.vscode` means the preview host and the hosts the product supports must satisfy the new minimum; a changed `version` means the product's own version policy decides what it ships; a renamed or removed configuration key means own code and the brand overlay that name the key break; a changed activation list means the entry module runs under new conditions; a changed package manager means the install, the lint and the build commands change their spelling; a locale manifest that appeared or vanished means an overlay target appeared or vanished. A difference with no meaning worth stopping for is not reported.

p.VSX-CONVENTIONS: The subsystems an intervention id may name: `extension`, `webview`, `i18n`, `assets`, `build`, `config`, `docs`, `test`. No forbidden service ids: the family has no service registry (PROP-003 `VSX-NO-SERVICE-OVERRIDE`). A product extends the subsystems additively through `conventionsExtensionFile` (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-003#CONVENTIONS-EXTENSION`).

p.VSX-GEN-FEATURE: `codkit gen feature <id> --title <text> [--setting] [--cold] …` writes, under `delta/own/<name>/`, the identifiers module (the feature id and, with `--setting`, the id of its setting under the product's configuration section), the feature module - a function `register<Name>(context)` that pushes its disposables into `context.subscriptions`, the shape every contribution of an extension takes - and the test beside them inside the feature directory (`spec://codkit/modules/vscode/PROP-008#GEN-TEST-LIVES-WITH-THE-FEATURE` is the shared rule); it prints the import line for the entry module (PROP-003 `VSX-ENTRY-MODULE`) and the reminders: call the register function from `activate`, and declare the unit in `patchset.delta.json`. The header of every file is the product's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-015#GEN-HEADER-IS-THE-PRODUCTS`).

p.VSX-GEN-BRAND: `codkit gen brand […]` of this type writes two modules and prints one text. `delta/own/common/brand.ts` is the brand table: a starter list of rules with one worked example, a self-contained `createBrandTransform(rules)` returning `(message, locale) => message`, and the export `brandMessage`; `delta/own/test/brand.leftovers.test.ts` is the leftover guard (`VSX-BRAND-LEFTOVER-GUARD`). The printed hook text is the wrap of a translate function - the line `return brandMessage(result, locale);` placed where the function would return its string - with the reminders that the product grafts it as a patch of type `hook` at each funnel it has (a translate function per surface, and a display-name constant), that the patch stays inside the budget of `spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-005#PATCH-HOOK-BUDGET`, and that the manifest's strings are not reached by any funnel and are an overlay (PROP-003 `VSX-REBRAND-SET`). The command, the header handling and the refusal over existing files are the engine's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-AREA-GENERATORS`).

p.VSX-BRAND-RULE-SHAPE: A rule of the table is `{find, replace, locales?, except?}`: `find` the original term, matched case-sensitively as a whole word or a whole token; `replace` its replacement; `locales`, when present, the list of locale tags the rule applies to - `*` for every locale not named by another rule of the same `find`, so that one term carries one replacement for one locale and another for the rest; `except`, when present, substrings whose presence in the message leaves it untouched - an address, an identifier, a licence line. The rules apply in order to one message; the transform is pure, total and never throws; a message without a match is returned as the same string.

p.VSX-BRAND-HOOK: The hook is a patch of the product, printed and never written: each funnel of the product is upstream code, the seam is the product's, and a marker patch of type `hook` with the three lines of the wrap is inside the hook budget. The funnels of a product are facts of the product, recorded in its own repository; the type names the shape of the wrap and nothing of any funnel.

p.VSX-BRAND-LEFTOVER-GUARD: The leftover guard is a contract test the generator writes: over the built bundle (`<extensionRoot>/dist/**`), the materialized manifest and the newest `.vsix` of the package outputs, read as a zip, it searches for every `find` term of the table and fails naming the file and the term on the first occurrence outside an allow-list that holds exactly the licence files and the third-party notices (`LICENSE*`, `THIRD_PARTY*`, `NOTICE*`, and what the product adds); it passes when every occurrence is inside the allow-list. It is the executable form of the rule that nothing leaves un-renamed quietly, and its identifier is declared in the `contractTests` of the brand unit, which is what makes the rebrand set inventoried and gated like any other intervention (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-010#CONTRACT-TESTS-MANDATE`).

p.DECISION-VSX-BRAND-TRANSFORM-SELF-CONTAI: **Decision:** the brand transform is generated self-contained into the own layer; the type delivers no runtime library. **Why:** the transform is one pure function; a `runtime-library` of the type would be a package, a managed-copy delivery and a drift check for one file, and the library of the first family (`spec://codkit/modules/vscode/PROP-007#RT-BRAND-ENGINE`) carries the dependency injection of an editor an extension does not have. **Considered and rejected:** importing the first family's `brandRules.ts` (wrong family); a shared package of one file. **When to revisit:** a second module shared by every product of this family - then `runtime-vscode-extension` is born and `gen brand` imports from it.
